title: uva aurita
intro: Uva aurita, commonly known as the bearberry or kinnikinnick, is a low-growing, evergreen shrub native to North America and Europe. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to support urinary tract health due to its high concentration of arbutin, a natural diuretic that helps to prevent and treat infections. The therapeutic actions of Uva aurita include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and protect the body from oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Uva aurita include arbutin, ursolic acid, and other polyphenolic compounds, which contribute to its potential health benefits and medicinal properties.
